as_told.title: Three-fingered being's touch and the download

plain: Deep Prasad, who describes himself as a researcher, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a night in 2019 in his own bedroom. He says the roof seemed to dissolve and he saw the underside of a rectangular craft, along with gray beings, and that a being with three fingers touched him. Prasad says he then felt a sudden download of knowledge, and the first thought that came to him was that the universe is teeming with life, which, if true, would mean he had direct contact with non-human beings.
